regime_context: TSX thematic detector shows Big Banks as the dominant leader (crowded, high durability, full breadth), with Base Metals as the sole challenger. The absolute-trend gate historically cuts drawdowns on this market, but cross-sectional momentum carries no predictive edge. Rotation margin is wide and no one-narrative dominance.
emerging_watch: Watch Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) for a confirmed leadership handoff: if its rotation score gap vs Big Banks narrows to within 0.20 and its breadth exceeds 0.5, that would confirm the handoff and retire this watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks exhibit strong absolute-trend eligibility, high durability (0.69), and full breadth, aligning with the detector's validated drawdown-avoidance gate. Overweight as a trend-following risk-control measure, acknowledging high crowding as a sizing caution.
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.05) and potential mean-reversion from BoC rate cuts could trigger profit-taking, limiting upside.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals passes the absolute-trend gate and remains uncrowded, offering materials-momentum exposure as a risk-control lean. Low conviction given fragile breadth (0.0) and moderate durability.
theses.dissent: Narrow breadth and commodity price sensitivity make the trend vulnerable to sudden reversals on a single day's copper move.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 2% over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology fails the absolute-trend gate, which historically reduces drawdowns for TSX themes; underweight as a volatility/drawdown control measure, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Global tech recovery or AI tailwinds could cause a sharp rebound, making underweight a relative performance drag.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX Composite by more than 5% over the next 30 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
